title: Passive — barcha zamonlarda
recall: Passive qanday yasaladi? Present perfect va continuous passive'ni ayt. by qachon kerak?
formula: be + V3: zamon 'be' da — is made, was made, has been made, is being made, will be made
ish qiluvchi muhim bo'lmasa yoki noma'lum bo'lsa; by + kim — faqat muhim bo'lsa
ikki to'ldiruvchi: I was given a book / A book was given to me; modal: must be done

en: English is spoken all over the world.
English is spoken around the world.
The road is being repaired now.
The letter will be sent tomorrow.
This book was written by Tolstoy.
The report hasn't been finished yet.
The report has not been finished yet.
This room is cleaned every day.
When we arrived, the house was being painted.
The house was being painted when we arrived.
The results will be announced next week.
This work must be done today.
This job has to be done today.
The building had been knocked down.
This phone was made in China.
This phone is made in China.
The children weren't told about it.
The children haven't been told about it.

speak: Shahringizda nima qurilgan, nima qurilmoqda, nima quriladi? (passive, 3 zamon)
Ishxonangizda qanday ishlar bajariladi? 5 ta gap.
